preview.overview: Notre Dame arrives in Provo as the belt holder, looking to extend a dominant stretch against a BYU team that has won five straight. The Fighting Irish have controlled this rivalry historically, but the Cougars won their last matchup in 2004 and will have the home-field advantage in a rare opportunity to reclaim the lineal championship.
key_matchups: Notre Dame's defensive dominance (three shutouts in last five games) against BYU's offensive consistency
BYU's home-field advantage and recent form versus Notre Dame's road pedigree and command of the all-time series
preview.betting_angles: Notre Dame's last five games show 58-7, 37-26, 49-10, 27-10, and 52-0 results, while BYU has posted 24-10, 17-10, 41-23, 28-17, and 63-7. The Fighting Irish lead the all-time series 7-2, and have won three of the last four meetings, including 28-20 in 2022. BYU's only recent success came in 2004 with a 20-17 win, suggesting Notre Dame enters as a heavy favorite despite traveling to Salt Lake City.
preview.prediction_writeup: Notre Dame's recent form is simply dominant, with four wins of 27 points or more in the last five games, including a 52-0 shutout of Rice. While BYU has momentum with five straight wins, none came against competition at Notre Dame's level. The Fighting Irish have thoroughly controlled this series since 2004, winning five of six meetings. BYU's home-field advantage provides some cover, but Notre Dame's proven ability to perform on the road and its defensive prowess make the visitors the clear choice to retain the belt.
